separation_rule: Structural presence or absence and functional assay evidence are separate records and must never be merged.
no_functional_evidence_note_tr: Bu reseptör–ligand çifti için kürasyonlu fonksiyonel deney kaydı yok; bu yüzden panel üyeliği tamamen yapıdaki sinyal ileticisinden geliyor.
no_functional_evidence_note_en: No curated functional assay record is available for this receptor–ligand pair; panel membership therefore comes entirely from the transducer observed in the structure.

A.description: Evidence from the deposited polymer inventory or a structural annotation.

B.description: Curated, source-linked functional assay evidence; never inferred from a structure.
